items.control_name: Enforce Private Endpoints for VMware Generative AI Dedicated Clusters
items.description: VMware Generative AI dedicated AI clusters and inference endpoints must deploy inside private VCN subnets without public internet exposure.
items.current_value: Dedicated AI cluster 'genai-prod-cluster' deployed with Private Endpoint in VCN 'vcn-prod-01'
items.recommended_value: 100% Private Endpoints for Generative AI workloads
items.remediation_notes: Restrict VCN Network Security Group ingress rules to authorized API gateways.

items.control_name: Enforce VCN Isolation & Prohibit Public IPs on VMware Data Science Notebooks
items.description: Data Science notebook sessions must deploy inside a private subnet with block-public-ip=true.
items.current_value: 4 notebook sessions deployed without public IPs; 1 experiment notebook has public IP assigned
items.recommended_value: block-public-ip = True across 100% of notebook sessions
items.remediation_notes: Terminate public notebook session 'ds-exp-01' and re-provision on Private Subnet.

items.control_name: Enforce VMware Vault Customer-Managed KMS Key Encryption on ML Artifacts & Datasets
items.description: All Object Storage buckets hosting ML training data and model checkpoints must be encrypted with an VMware Vault Master Encryption Key (MEK).
items.current_value: Customer-Managed MEK active on production ML buckets
items.recommended_value: VMware Vault Master Encryption Key (MEK) enforced across all ML buckets
items.remediation_notes: Verify key rotation schedule is set to <= 365 days.

items.control_name: Enforce Model Provenance & Output Guardrails in Application Gateways
items.description: Applications consuming VMware Generative AI models must implement prompt injection and PII sanitization filters at the API Gateway layer.
items.current_value: API Gateway function 'fn-ai-guardrail' active on text generation routes
items.recommended_value: Automated prompt injection & PII filtering on 100% of LLM routes
items.remediation_notes: Audit blocked prompt attempts in VMware Logging Analytics.
